title: AI + Product Design Morning Brief

highlights.headline: AI spending is cooling and valuations are sliding.
highlights.summary: [Ramp data](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/06/ramp-data-shows-ai-spending-stalling-just-as-anthropic-nears-its-ipo/) shows token spend grew just 1.5% across August and September, while [Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com) and [OpenAI](https://openai.com) IPO valuation targets reportedly dropped.

highlights.headline: Figma is turning into a code-and-agent workspace.
highlights.summary: [Figma](https://www.figma.com) shipped agent-generated vector illustrations (Nov 5) and a code layer agent that reads prototype connections (Nov 3).

highlights.headline: OpenAI ships a Critical-rated security model.
highlights.summary: [OpenAI's Linux kernel study](https://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root/) reports 948 working privilege-escalation exploits from a model at about $1,279 each.

highlights.headline: Agent orchestration is consolidating.
highlights.summary: [Meta](https://www.meta.com) is acquiring [Conductor](https://conductor.build/), and [OpenAI](https://openai.com) is buying [Pierre](https://openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-pierre/), whose libraries power parts of the Codex app.

highlights.headline: Trust and cost are the new agent friction.
highlights.summary: A top [Hacker News thread](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50385272) (1,547 points) flags Claude Code sending email addresses to websites, and Apple is cutting engineers' AI token allowances.

section_notes.GitHub & Open Source: Star counts come from third-party roundups and were not independently verified.

entries.headline: AI spend stalls as price cuts bite
entries.summary: [Ramp's AI Index](https://ramp.com/data/ai-index?metric=token-spend&detail=maker&mode=volume) shows token spend up only 1.5% across August and September after a 42% jump from June to July, then 8.9% growth from Sept 23 to Oct 23. Median firms spend $12 to $15 per employee per month. [OpenAI halved API prices for GPT-6 Sol and Luna](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-6-sol-and-luna/), and Anthropic cut prices too. Bloomberg reported Anthropic's potential valuation fell from about $2 trillion to $1.2 to $1.3 trillion. Source: [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/06/ramp-data-shows-ai-spending-stalling-just-as-anthropic-nears-its-ipo/).
entries.why_it_matters: Usage is rising while revenue per token falls.

takeaway.label: For builders
takeaway.text: expect cheaper models and more pressure to prove ROI on every AI feature you ship.

links.label: AI spend stalls as price cuts bite
OpenAI halved API prices for GPT-6 Sol and Luna

entries.headline: OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber and the Linux kernel study
entries.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Cyber, rated "Critical" under its Preparedness Framework, to vetted customers first via API and Codex. Its [Linux study](https://openai.com/index/a-thousand-fewer-paths-to-root/) reports 1,724 reproduced issues and 948 working local privilege-escalation exploits, against 166 in a prior run. Coverage: [DEV Community digest](https://dev.to/hiroki-ii-ai/ai-daily-digest-november-6-2026-openai-ships-gpt-6-cyber-meta-buys-conductor-anthropic-locks-1jij).
entries.why_it_matters: Agents now find real vulnerabilities at scale.

takeaway.label: For builders
takeaway.text: assume AI-assisted attackers and tighten dependency and sandbox hygiene.

links.label: OpenAI GPT-6 Cyber and the Linux kernel study

entries.headline: Meta buys Conductor, OpenAI buys Pierre
entries.summary: [Conductor announced it is joining Meta](https://conductor.build/announcement). New sign-ups closed Nov 4, cloud goes read-only Nov 13, and data deletion starts Nov 20. [OpenAI said it will acquire Pierre](https://openai.com/index/openai-to-acquire-pierre/), pending regulatory approval. Source: [Agent Tools Today](https://munderdiffl.in/blog/agent-tools-today-2026-11-05/).
entries.why_it_matters: Multi-agent workspaces are becoming platform features.

takeaway.label: For designers
takeaway.text: if you use Conductor Cloud, export your data before Nov 13.

links.label: Meta buys Conductor, OpenAI buys Pierre
OpenAI said it will acquire Pierre

entries.headline: Anthropic ships enterprise security controls
entries.summary: [Anthropic](https://claude.com/news) made prompt hooks and pre-tool-call hooks generally available for [Claude](https://claude.com), so DLP vendors can inspect prompts and tool calls. A security center and a multi-org parent console are in beta. Anthropic's revised IPO filing also says it "may imminently meet" its definition of dramatically accelerated AI-driven progress ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/02/anthropic-warns-that-its-very-close-to-rsi-capability-aka-self-building-ai/)).
entries.why_it_matters: Agent governance is now a purchasing criterion.

takeaway.label: For builders
takeaway.text: hook-based approval flows are a UX surface worth designing well.

entries.headline: Agents are not buying anything yet
entries.summary: [Uber](https://www.uber.com) said agents booked 4 rides and about 500 food orders in its busiest October week out of roughly 320 million trips and orders ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/04/almost-no-one-uses-ai-agents-to-book-their-uber-company-says/)). [DoorDash](https://www.doordash.com) reported only several hundred agent orders ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/30/doordash-said-its-only-received-several-hundred-orders-from-ai-agents/)).
entries.why_it_matters: Agentic commerce is hype ahead of behavior.

takeaway.label: For designers
takeaway.text: human-in-the-loop checkout is still the real product.

links.label: Agents are not buying anything yet

entries.headline: Cost control at the big companies
entries.summary: [Apple](https://www.apple.com) reportedly cut some engineers' daily AI cap from $300 to $200 ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/11/04/report-apple-reduces-employees-ai-token-allowances-as-ternus-moves-to-cut-costs/)). [Revolut](https://www.revolut.com) says it cut AI coding costs about 90% by self-hosting GLM ([The Register](https://www.theregister.com/ai-and-ml/2026/11/03/british-fintech-revolut-slashes-ai-coding-costs-10x-by-cutting-out-claude-and-going-self-hosted/5307345), company-reported).
entries.why_it_matters: token efficiency is a skill. Learn to pick the cheapest model that passes your evals.

links.label: Cost control at the big companies

entries.headline: Figma: agent-made vectors and code layers
entries.summary: [Figma](https://www.figma.com) now lets agents generate vector illustrations and icons with editable layers and strokes, ready for Figma Motion (Nov 5). The code layer agent reads prototype connections in open beta (Nov 3), and shader export reaches 4096px (Nov 2). Details: [Figma release notes via Releasebot](https://releasebot.io/updates/figma), plus the [code layers announcement](https://www.figma.com/blog/design-together-with-code-layers/).
entries.why_it_matters: prototypes can carry real logic without a handoff, and icon sets can be drafted by an agent then hand-tuned.

links.label: Figma: agent-made vectors and code layers

entries.headline: Figma MCP gains Weave models
entries.summary: Weave video and image models are now reachable through the [Figma](https://www.figma.com) MCP (Oct 26), and organizations can publish internal Weave tools (Oct 30).
entries.why_it_matters: generate assets from the same agent session that edits your file.

entries.headline: Cursor: agents as products
entries.summary: [Cursor](https://cursor.com) released an [Agent SDK](https://cursor.com/changelog/agent-sdk) (Oct 20), [cloud agent canvases](https://cursor.com/changelog/cloud-agent-canvases-and-environments) that produce shareable artifacts (Oct 16), and an [app marketplace](https://cursor.com/changelog/origin-app-marketplace) with partners such as [Linear](https://linear.app) (Oct 13).
entries.why_it_matters: designers can ask a cloud agent for a shareable canvas instead of screenshots.

entries.headline: Grok Bot phones people for you
entries.summary: xAI's Grok Bot can hold calls, book appointments, and negotiate bills, and the terms make the user the "caller of record" ([post on X](https://x.com/bot/status/2118043939592942052)).

takeaway.label: Design angle
takeaway.text: consent and liability language is now part of the interface.

links.label: Grok Bot phones people for you

entries.summary: [vercel-labs/agent-desktop](https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-desktop) reads OS accessibility trees instead of screenshots.

entries.headline: Design and code merging
entries.summary: Figma code layers and Cursor canvases blur the handoff.

takeaway.label: Learn

entries.headline: Cost discipline
entries.summary: Price cuts, token caps, and self-hosting (see Revolut above) mean model choice is a design constraint.

entries.headline: Figma's editable agent illustrations
entries.summary: The [Nov 5 update](https://releasebot.io/updates/figma) returns agent output as real layers and strokes rather than flattened images.
entries.why_it_matters: the result stays inside the designer's existing editing model.

entries.headline: Cursor cloud agent canvases
entries.summary: [Canvases](https://cursor.com/changelog/cloud-agent-canvases-and-environments) give agents a shareable visual output instead of a wall of text.
entries.why_it_matters: stakeholders can review without opening a repo.

entries.headline: Conductor's parallel workspaces
entries.summary: [Conductor](https://conductor.build/) showed one workspace per agent, side by side, with diffs front and center.
entries.why_it_matters: it makes parallel work legible, which is why [Meta](https://www.meta.com) bought it.

entries.headline: Agent-test your own onboarding
entries.summary: Install [Gauge CLI](https://github.com/gauge-sh/gauge-cli), point it at one onboarding flow of a product you built, and read where the agent gets stuck. Fix the two worst labels or missing states, then rerun. Note the before and after. If install fails, use [AutoCua](https://github.com/ComputerUseAgent/AutoCua) for the same task.
